articles.title: PE firm Pollen Street to acquire Finastra's core banking software unit
articles.summary: UK-based private equity firm Pollen Street Capital on Friday said that it ‌will acquire financial software company Finastra's global core ‌banking software business Universal Banking (UB). The firms did not disclose the ​terms of the deal. Here are some details: • UB provides banking services including account and deposit management, payments, lending and treasury operations to financial institutions, and will operate ‌as an independent ⁠business under its existing management following the deal.
